Criteria: Stand with an upright posture and arms extended vertically. Legs together or one leg ahead with toes pointed.
Take a large step forward. Bring the swing leg up while hands reach the floor. Torso and swing leg form a straight line.
Swing the supporting leg up, bringing the hips over the shoulders. Press extended legs together. Hands remain in place.
Maintain a straight line from wrists to ankles. Engage the core to prevent the back from arching. Gaze between the thumbs.
Step down starting with one leg in a controlled manner. Finish in an upright position with arms up.
